title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
heroDesc: Every pack of dry fruits, cashews, and walnuts is hermetically sealed to preserve farm-fresh crispness and dispatched via express air/surface couriers.

cards.title: Shipping Coverage & Free Delivery
cards.subtitle: All India Delivery
paragraphs: We deliver to over 19,000+ PIN codes across all 28 Indian states and union territories using verified express logistics partners (Delhivery, Blue Dart, DTDC, India Post Speed Post).
bullets: Free Express Shipping: Available on all orders with a cart subtotal of ₹499 or more.
Standard Delivery Fee: A nominal flat fee of ₹49 applies to smaller orders below ₹499.

cards.title: Dispatch & Delivery Timelines
cards.subtitle: Estimated Delivery Days
bullets: Order Processing Time: All orders are freshly packed and dispatched from our origin warehouse within 24 to 48 business hours of order confirmation.
Metro & Tier 1 Cities: Typically delivered within 2 to 4 business days post-dispatch.
Rest of India (Tier 2/3 & Remote): Typically delivered within 3 to 6 business days.
Orders placed on Sundays or National Holidays will be processed on the next immediate working day.
cards.highlight: Live SMS Tracking: You will receive real-time SMS updates with a direct tracking link as soon as your parcel is packed and handed over to the courier partner.

cards.title: Tamper-Proof Freshness Packaging
cards.subtitle: Vacuum Sealed & Moisture Proof
paragraphs: To ensure zero breakage and maximum freshness, all whole kernel cashews, roasted nuts, and saffron honey jars are packed in food-grade multi-layer nitrogen-flushed pouches and rigid corrugated outer boxes.

cards.title: Damaged or Tampered Shipments
cards.subtitle: Instant Replacement Guarantee
paragraphs: If the outer box or courier seal appears tampered, cut, or damaged at the time of delivery:
bullets: Please mention 'Damaged / Tampered Condition' on the courier proof-of-delivery (POD) sheet.
Take 2–3 clear photos/videos of the package and reach out to our support within 48 hours.
We will dispatch a free express replacement immediately with zero hassle.

sections.summary: Free Express Delivery on orders above ₹499; flat ₹49 on smaller orders.
sections.content: Free Express Shipping is available on all orders with a cart subtotal of ₹499 or more. For smaller orders below ₹499, a nominal standard packaging and transit fee of ₹49 applies at checkout.

sections.summary: 24-48 hours dispatch; 2-4 days metro delivery; 3-6 days rest of India.
sections.content: All orders are freshly packed and dispatched from our origin fulfillment hub within 24 to 48 hours of confirmation. Metro cities (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Hyderabad) typically arrive within 2 to 4 business days. Regional and tier 2/3 locations take 3 to 6 business days.

sections.summary: Serving 19,000+ PIN codes across all 28 states via express air courier partners.
sections.content: We deliver to over 19,000+ PIN codes across all 28 Indian states and Union Territories via tier-1 express air partners including Delhivery, Blue Dart, DTDC, and India Post Speed Post.

sections.summary: Nitrogen-flushed, multi-layer airtight canisters retaining peak crunch.
sections.content: To guarantee zero transit breakage and maximum crunch, all whole cashews, roasted snacks, and seeds are packed in food-grade multi-layer nitrogen-flushed airtight tins and rigid outer corrugated boxes.
